# Prometheus scrape configuration for the Space Fractions local Compose topology.
#
# Reference-only monitoring integration: the gateway exposes GET /metrics on
# container port 3000 in the standard Prometheus text exposition format
# (see packages/gateway/src/index.js and src/metrics.js). This file is consumed
# by the `prometheus` service in compose.yaml as a bind-mounted, read-only config.
#
# Service discovery uses Compose DNS names. The scrape interval is short for
# local-only observability; it is not a production tuning recommendation.

global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "space-fractions-gateway"
    metrics_path: "/metrics"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["gateway:3000"]

# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.
#
# Reference: Architecture_Documentation.md lines 130-156 (deployment), and the
# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    container_name: spacefractions-keycloak
    command: start-dev
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 && grep -q openid-configuration <&3 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:
      - gateway

volumes:
  pg_data:

# Prometheus scrape configuration for the Space Fractions local Compose topology.
#
# Reference-only monitoring integration: the gateway exposes GET /metrics on
# container port 3000 in the standard Prometheus text exposition format
# (see packages/gateway/src/index.js and src/metrics.js). This file is consumed
# by the `prometheus` service in compose.yaml as a bind-mounted, read-only config.
#
# Service discovery uses Compose DNS names. The scrape interval is short for
# local-only observability; it is not a production tuning recommendation.

global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "space-fractions-gateway"
    metrics_path: "/metrics"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["gateway:3000"]

# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.
#
# Reference: Architecture_Documentation.md lines 130-156 (deployment), and the
# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    container_name: spacefractions-keycloak
    command: start-dev
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 && grep -q openid-configuration <&3 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:
      - gateway

volumes:
  pg_data:

# Space Fractions — environment template (placeholders only).
#
# Copy to .env for local Compose runs:
#   cp .env.example .env
#   docker compose up --build
#
# Every value below is a LOCAL-ONLY placeholder. Demo accounts/credentials in
# infra/keycloak/realm.json are local development fixtures and are NOT
# production guidance. All public browser URLs/redirects derive from
# PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime (the acceptance
# harness remaps host ports), so never hard-code host ports in code.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public browser origin served by the gateway. The harness overrides this to a
# temporary random-port origin; the default is the local dev host binding.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identity provider (Keycloak) public URLs. OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer
# that appears in tokens and must match what the browser reaches; the backend
# JWKS lookup uses the internal container address below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
OIDC_ISSUER=http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions
OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080

# Internal (container-network) JWKS endpoint consumed by backend services.
# Do not change this to a value the backend cannot reach from inside Compose.
OIDC_JWKS_URI=http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs

# Expected token audience (mapped by the account audience mapper in the realm).
OIDC_AUDIENCE=account

# Realm role required for administrator question CRUD.
OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE=admin

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PostgreSQL (source of truth). Shown here for reference; Compose wires these
# internally. Override only if you run services outside Compose.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ELASTICSEARCH_URL=http://localhost:9200

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# GAME_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3001

# container port 3000 in the standard Prometheus text exposition format

# by the `prometheus` service in compose.yaml as a bind-mounted, read-only config.
#
# Service discovery uses Compose DNS names. The scrape interval is short for
# local-only observability; it is not a production tuning recommendation.

global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "space-fractions-gateway"
    metrics_path: "/metrics"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["gateway:3000"]

#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:

    depends_on:

      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs

      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:

    environment:

    ports:

      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro

# Space Fractions gateway image (public edge, container port 3000).
#
# Build context is the repository root (see compose.yaml). Runtime mirrors the
# gateway service in compose: it serves the browser UI at "/", proxies API
# requests to downstream services (game/question/user/admin), and exposes
# /health and /metrics. All configuration comes from environment variables —
# nothing (ports, redirects, tokens) is baked into the image.

FROM node:22-alpine

WORKDIR /usr/src/app

# Install production dependencies first for a stable, cached layer. The root
# package.json declares any runtime deps for the gateway; the gateway itself
# uses only Node built-ins (http/fs/path), so this step may be a no-op when a
# lockfile is absent. It is kept to stay correct if a runtime dependency is
# added without changing this build topology.
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts || true

# Copy only what the gateway needs at runtime. The gateway serves static UI
# from packages/gateway/public and requires packages/gateway/src/index.js as
# its entrypoint. Copying the full tree keeps any future shared requires (e.g.
# src/*) available without an additional COPY rule.
COPY . .

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000

# Bind-mounted static assets can override the default packaged UI, matching the
# GATEWAY_STATIC_DIR escape hatch in packages/gateway/src/index.js.
EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "packages/gateway/src/index.js"]

# Space Fractions — environment template (placeholders only).
#
# Copy to .env for local Compose runs:
#   cp .env.example .env
#   docker compose up --build
#
# Every value below is a LOCAL-ONLY placeholder. Demo accounts/credentials in
# infra/keycloak/realm.json are local development fixtures and are NOT
# production guidance. All public browser URLs/redirects derive from
# PUBLIC_ORIGIN and OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime (the acceptance
# harness remaps host ports), so never hard-code host ports in code.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public browser origin served by the gateway. The harness overrides this to a
# temporary random-port origin; the default is the local dev host binding.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identity provider (Keycloak) public URLs. OIDC_ISSUER is the public issuer
# that appears in tokens and must match what the browser reaches; the backend
# JWKS lookup uses the internal container address below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
OIDC_ISSUER=http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions
OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080

# Internal (container-network) JWKS endpoint consumed by backend services.
# Do not change this to a value the backend cannot reach from inside Compose.
OIDC_JWKS_URI=http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs

# Expected token audience (mapped by the account audience mapper in the realm).
OIDC_AUDIENCE=account

# Realm role required for administrator question CRUD.
OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE=admin

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PostgreSQL (source of truth). Shown here for reference; Compose wires these
# internally. Override only if you run services outside Compose.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATABASE_URL=postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@localhost:5432/spacefractions

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backing infrastructure URLs (container-network). Used by services when run
# locally rather than via Compose.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ELASTICSEARCH_URL=http://localhost:9200
# RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@localhost:5672

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Downstream service URLs used by the gateway for proxying.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GAME_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3001
# QUESTION_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3002
# USER_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3003
# ADMIN_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3004

# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.
#
# Reference: Architecture_Documentation.md lines 130-156 (deployment), and the
# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    container_name: spacefractions-keycloak
    command: start-dev
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 && grep -q openid-configuration <&3 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:
      - gateway

volumes:
  pg_data:

-- Space Fractions — idempotent seed data
--
-- Seeds the demo users (student/admin/other), the default sixth-grade
-- fraction question bank, and a reproducible practice game for the demo
-- student. Every correct_answer is a valid single fraction accepted by the
-- shared validator (src/shared/fraction.js): either an integer or a simple
-- "a/b" fraction in lowest terms (origin=assumption on exact string grammar).
--
-- Idempotency strategy:
--   - Users are upserted by OIDC subject (UNIQUE users.subject) so the same
--     demo account is reused across replays rather than duplicated.
--   - Questions are inserted deterministically with a stable ordinal key
--     (subject-less natural key encoded via md5 of prompt||correct_answer) to
--     avoid duplication while keeping ids reproducible across clean installs.
--   - The demo game is inserted only if the student has no existing game with
--     the reserved sentinel so replays do not pile up rows.
--
-- The password-grant/demo accounts below are LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; do not use
-- them in production. The Keycloak realm (infra/keycloak/realm.json) defines
-- the same subjects as the authoritative OIDC identities.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Demo users (subjects match the Keycloak realm demo accounts).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO users (subject, profile, roles)
VALUES
  ('student', 'Student Demo', '{}'),
  ('admin',   'Admin Demo',   '{admin}'),
  ('other',   'Other Demo',   '{}')
ON CONFLICT (subject) DO UPDATE
  SET profile = EXCLUDED.profile,
      roles   = EXCLUDED.roles,
      updated_at = now();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Default question bank. correct_answer is a canonical single fraction.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO questions (prompt, options, correct_answer)
SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  (
    'What is 1/2 + 1/4?',
    '["1/4", "3/4", "2/6", "1/2"]'::jsonb,
    '3/4'
  ),
  (
    'What is 2/3 - 1/6?',
    '["1/2", "1/3", "1/6", "2/6"]'::jsonb,
    '1/2'
  ),
  (
    'Simplify 4/8.',
    '["1/2", "4/8", "2/4", "1/4"]'::jsonb,
    '1/2'
  ),
  (
    'What is 1/3 + 1/6?',
    '["1/2", "1/6", "2/9", "1/3"]'::jsonb,
    '1/2'
  ),
  (
    'What is 3/4 - 1/4?',
    '["1/2", "1/4", "2/4", "1"]'::jsonb,
    '1/2'
  ),
  (
    'What is 1/5 + 2/5?',
    '["3/5", "2/5", "3/10", "1/5"]'::jsonb,
    '3/5'
  ),
  (
    'Simplify 6/9.',
    '["2/3", "3/2", "6/9", "2/6"]'::jsonb,
    '2/3'
  ),
  (
    'What is 1/2 of 1/3?',
    '["1/6", "1/5", "2/3", "1/3"]'::jsonb,
    '1/6'
  )
) AS v(prompt, options, correct_answer)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM questions q
  WHERE q.prompt = v.prompt AND q.correct_answer = v.correct_answer
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reproducible practice game for the demo student (five questions in stable
-- order). Uses a sentinel game_state marker so replays are skipped.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
WITH student AS (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE subject = 'student' LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO games (owner_id, state, score, game_state)
SELECT s.id, 'in_progress', 0, '{"seed":"practice-1"}'::jsonb
FROM student s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM games g
  WHERE g.owner_id = s.id AND g.game_state->>'seed' = 'practice-1'
);

-- Populate game_questions for the seed game in stable position order.
WITH seed_game AS (
  SELECT id FROM games WHERE game_state->>'seed' = 'practice-1' LIMIT 1
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT q.id AS question_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY q.id) AS position
  FROM questions q
  ORDER BY q.id
  LIMIT 5
),
student AS (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE subject = 'student' LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO game_questions (game_id, question_id, position)
SELECT sg.id, o.question_id, o.position::int
FROM seed_game sg, ordered o, student s
WHERE sg.id IN (SELECT id FROM games WHERE owner_id = s.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM game_questions gq
    WHERE gq.game_id = sg.id AND gq.question_id = o.question_id
  )
ON CONFLICT (game_id, question_id) DO NOTHING;

-- Space Fractions — schema migration 001
--
-- PostgreSQL 16 source-of-truth schema. The original design (Architecture
-- Documentation lines 118-124) defines:
--
--   CREATE TABLE games (
--     id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
--     game_state JSONB NOT NULL
--   );
--
-- The operator supplement (space-fractions.md lines 47-50) requires normalized
-- ownership of game state: "PostgreSQL must own all game state; map verified
-- sub strings to numeric internal user IDs." The 'games' table name is kept,
-- and the JSONB game_state is expanded into normalized child tables
-- (game_questions, answers) while preserving the canonical 'games' identifier.
--
-- Contracts (space-fractions.md line 48):
--   - games(id, owner_id, state, score)
--   - unique(users.subject)  -- one internal user per OIDC subject
--   - unique answers(game_id, question_id)  -- dedup per game
--
-- This file is idempotent: it uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and idempotent
-- index creation so the migration runner may replay it safely.

BEGIN;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Users — verified OIDC subjects mapped to numeric internal IDs.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id          SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  subject     TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  roles       TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_subject_key
  ON users (subject);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Questions — six-grade fraction prompts with an exact rational correct
-- answer. options is a JSON array of strings; correct_answer is a single
-- fraction in canonical "a/b" (or integer) form accepted by the shared
-- fraction validator.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS questions (
  id             SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  prompt         TEXT NOT NULL,
  options        JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  correct_answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Games — preserves the original 'games' table name. game_state JSONB is
-- retained for original-design compatibility (intro/menu/play phase state),
-- while ownership and score are promoted to typed columns for authorization
-- and transactional scoring.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games (
  id         SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  state      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress'
             CHECK (state IN ('in_progress', 'paused', 'finished')),
  score      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  game_state JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS games_owner_idx ON games (owner_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- game_questions — the ordered set of questions composing a game. position
-- guarantees a stable question order (assumption noted in plan).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_questions (
  game_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (game_id, question_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS game_questions_position_idx
  ON game_questions (game_id, position);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- answers — submitted answers. The UNIQUE (game_id, question_id) constraint
-- deduplicates repeats in the same transaction, preventing double scoring.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS answers (
  id          SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  game_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  answer      TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct     BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (game_id, question_id)
);

COMMIT;

# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.

# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).

# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5

    command: start-dev
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).

      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.

      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 && grep -q openid-configuration <&3 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:
      - gateway

volumes:
  pg_data:

# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.
#
# Reference: Architecture_Documentation.md lines 130-156 (deployment), and the
# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    container_name: spacefractions-keycloak
    # --import-realm is required in Keycloak 24 to load the bind-mounted realm
    # from /opt/keycloak/data/import on startup (start-dev does not import by
    # default). Without it the space-fractions realm is absent and both the
    # healthcheck and OIDC endpoints 404, leaving the container unhealthy.
    command: start-dev --import-realm
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
      # Do not reject requests whose Host header differs from the running
      # container's own hostname (needed when the harness remaps the public
      # port/origin). This is safe for the local-only demo topology.
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 && grep -q openid-configuration <&3 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:
      - gateway

volumes:
  pg_data:

The problem is clear: `realm.json` has `"directGrantGrantsEnabled": true` at the realm level, but that's a **client**-level property, not a realm-level property. The realm-level property is `directGrantFlowEnabled`. Let me check the actual Keycloak property name and fix.

Actually, looking at the error: `Unrecognized field "directGrantGrantsEnabled"` — that's a typo. The client already correctly has `directAccessGrantsEnabled: true`. The realm-level `directGrantGrantsEnabled` is invalid.

The realm-level correct property is `directGrantFlowEnabled`. But actually, the requirement says "explicitly enable directAccessGrantsEnabled for this local-only demo" — which is already done on the client. The realm-level property `directGrantGrantsEnabled` is a typo and should be removed entirely (or set as `directGrantFlowEnabled`).

Let me fix this by removing the invalid realm-level property

The fix is applied. The realm-level property `directGrantGrantsEnabled` was invalid (that's a client-level property name) and caused Keycloak to fail import with `UnrecognizedField`. The correct realm-level property is `directGrantFlowEnabled`, which enables password/direct grant flow at the realm level. Combined with the client's existing `directAccessGrantsEnabled: true`, this satisfies the "explicitly enable directAccessGrantsEnabled for this local-only demo" requirement.

Let me verify the fix and run the runtime check to confirm.

result.content:
# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.
#
# Reference: Architecture_Documentation.md lines 130-156 (deployment), and the
# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    container_name: spacefractions-keycloak
    # --import-realm is required in Keycloak 24 to load the bind-mounted realm
    # from /opt/keycloak/data/import on startup (start-dev does not import by
    # default). Without it the space-fractions realm is absent and both the
    # healthcheck and OIDC endpoints 404, leaving the container unhealthy.
    command: start-dev --import-realm
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
      # Do not reject requests whose Host header differs from the running
      # container's own hostname (needed when the harness remaps the public
      # port/origin). This is safe for the local-only demo topology.
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n' >&3 && grep -q openid-configuration <&3 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

# Space Fractions — local Compose topology.
#
# Reference: Architecture_Documentation.md lines 130-156 (deployment), and the
# operator supplement space-fractions.md lines 30-45 (service IDs, ports,
# Keycloak runtime contract). This file wires the full microservices topology:
#
#   gateway (3000) -> game-service (3001), question-service (3002),
#                     user-service (3003), admin-service (3004)
#   postgres (source of truth), redis (cache), rabbitmq (score events),
#   elasticsearch (question search), keycloak (OIDC), prometheus (metrics).
#
# NOTE: the browser gateway container listens on port 3000 and Keycloak on 8080
# internally. Public browser URLs/redirects are derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN and
# OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime — never from a hard-coded host port
# (the acceptance harness remaps host ports). Demo users/credentials below are
# LOCAL-ONLY fixtures; they are not production guidance.

name: space-fractions

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3.13-management-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:24.0.5
    container_name: spacefractions-keycloak
    # --import-realm is required in Keycloak 24 to load the bind-mounted realm
    # from /opt/keycloak/data/import on startup (start-dev does not import by
    # default). Without it the space-fractions realm is absent and both the
    # healthcheck and OIDC endpoints 404, leaving the container unhealthy.
    command: start-dev --import-realm
    environment:
      # Local-only bootstrap admin (distinct from the app's realm admin user).
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      # Public frontend origin derives from OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN at runtime so
      # realm redirect/issuer links match a remapped test origin.
      KC_HOSTNAME_URL: ${OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:8080}
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8080
      KC_PROXY: edge
      # Do not reject requests whose Host header differs from the running
      # container's own hostname (needed when the harness remaps the public
      # port/origin). This is safe for the local-only demo topology.
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT_HTTPS: "false"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Realm (space-fractions) import: demo users student/admin/other, public
      # client space-fractions-client (PKCE S256, direct grants enabled for the
      # local-only password fixtures only). Bind-mounted and must exist.
      - ./infra/keycloak/realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      # Keycloak 24 image has bash but no curl/wget. /dev/tcp redirection is a
      # bash-ism, so the probe MUST run under bash (CMD-SHELL uses /bin/sh,
      # where /dev/tcp is unsupported). Pure-bash probe: open a socket, send a
      # minimal HTTP/1.0 request, and exit 0 if any response arrives (a closed
      # connection/refused connect makes exec fail and returns non-zero).
      # NOTE: "$$" escapes Compose variable interpolation so a literal "$" and
      # "line" reach bash.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf \"GET /realms/space-fractions/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\" >&3 && IFS= read -r line <&3 && case \"$$line\" in *\" 200 \"*|*\" 201 \"*|*\" 302 \"*) exit 0;; *) exit 1;; esac'"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12

  user-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/user-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-user-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3003"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  question-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/question-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-question-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3002"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions

    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy

  admin-service:

      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/admin-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-admin-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3004"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  game-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/game-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-game-service
    environment:
      PORT: "3001"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://spacefractions:spacefractions@postgres:5432/spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://spacefractions:spacefractions@rabbitmq:5672
      OIDC_ISSUER: ${OIDC_ISSUER:-http://localhost:8080/realms/space-fractions}
      OIDC_JWKS_URI: http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OIDC_AUDIENCE: account
      OIDC_ADMIN_ROLE: admin
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy

  gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: packages/gateway/Dockerfile
    container_name: spacefractions-gateway
    environment:
      PORT: "3000"
      # Public browser origin derived from PUBLIC_ORIGIN (never a fixed port).
      PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      GAME_SERVICE_URL: http://game-service:3001
      QUESTION_SERVICE_URL: http://question-service:3002
      USER_SERVICE_URL: http://user-service:3003
      ADMIN_SERVICE_URL: http://admin-service:3004
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      game-service:
        condition: service_started
      question-service:
        condition: service_started
      user-service:
        condition: service_started
      admin-service:
        condition: service_started

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.1
    container_name: spacefractions-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./infra/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    depends_on:
      - gateway

      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: spacefractions
      POSTGRES_DB: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Idempotent schema + seed applied on FIRST boot only (empty data dir).
      # The hand-rolled composite also replays migration 001 + seed, but those
      # files are idempotent (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT) so re-running
      # against an existing volume is safe.
      - ./sql/migrations/001_schema.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_schema.sql:ro
      - ./sql/seed.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U spacefractions -d spacefractions"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: spacefractions-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  rabbitmq:

    container_name: spacefractions-rabbitmq
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: spacefractions
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: spacefractions
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.14.3
    container_name: spacefractions-elasticsearch
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: "false"
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
    ports:

      timeout: 10s
